journey.name: Add first item
journey.description: From an empty wardrobe, opens the Add-item sheet and the photo-source dialog, verifying the form and its fields are present. Start state: fresh install with an empty wardrobe.

actions.action: Verify the Wardrobe screen shows the empty state: the "No items yet" title and an "Add your first item" button.
Tap the "Add your first item" button.
Verify the "Add new item" sheet is shown with a "Tap to add photo" photo area, an "Item name" field, and a "Category" selector.
Tap the "Tap to add photo" area.
Verify the "Add photo" dialog is shown with "Take photo" and "Choose from gallery" options.
Tap "Cancel" to dismiss the photo dialog.
Verify the "Add new item" sheet is still shown and the "Save to wardrobe" button is present.
